newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Toro insurer Q1 premium income up.
newsitem.headline: Italy Toro insurer Q1 premium income up.

text.p: Italy's Toro Assicurazioni, part of the Fiat group, said first quarter 1997 group premium income rose 17.7 percent to 1.003 trillion lire.
The insurer, announcing the figure at a weekend shareholders' meeting, said parent company premium income rose 7.4 percent to 422 billion lire.
Managing Director Francesco Torri said that for the whole of 1997 "prospects remain positive with the goal of results at 1996 levels."
Toro posted 1996 net profit of 152.8 billion lire against a previous 166.5 billion.
The AGM approved the payment of a 1996 ordinary dividend of 440 lire, against 400 lire, and a dividend per savings share of 460 lire against a previous 420 lire.
